captions_meta.li_hook:
The businesses that get coverage around big moments prepared their releases weeks earlier.
A 2027 PR calendar framework for Australia.
li_body: Small businesses make up 97% of actively trading businesses in Australia (ASBFEO, 2026), and they all compete for the same news days. Preparation, not volume, decides who gets covered.
li_points: Q1: the mid-January return to work, when newsrooms are hungry for news, plus half-year results.
Q2: Federal Budget commentary (usually May) and EOFY angles.
Q3: new financial year plans, hires and pricing, plus partnership and funding news.
Q4: Black Friday and Cyber Monday, then publish before the Christmas shutdown.
For every moment: T-14 research, T-7 final release, T-3 pitch, Day 0 publish, T+3 recap.
